title: Presentation2Course outline
description: The summarizer's only output. Every later phase reads it.

subject_domain.description: Selects the shipped theme. Affects nothing else.

source_decks.description: Normalized PDF filenames this outline was read from.

name.description: Full language name, e.g. 'Hebrew'. Human-readable/documentation only -- validated as a non-empty string but never read by any code path. Changing it changes nothing about rendering; only 'code' drives behavior.

code.description: ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'he'. Must be exactly two letters (validated against that shape, not just non-empty); looked up against a fixed known-RTL-code list to decide layout direction.

language.description: The language every piece of student-authored content (prose, analogies, quizzes, glossary definitions) is written in. Required -- resolved once in Phase 0 from what the user explicitly stated, never defaulted. UI chrome, KNOWN-ISSUES.md's scaffolding, and the final report stay in English regardless -- see the design spec's Amendments section.

prerequisites.description: Rendered as a callout at the start of the module.

id.description: Unique course-wide. Becomes the <!-- topic: id --> marker.

slide_refs.description: Normalized deck filename and 1-based page, e.g. week1.pdf#12.

jargon.description: Every term a first-time reader would not know. Each one must end up with a glossary entry.

diagrams.description: Prose description of what each slide diagram shows, since the writer never sees the slide.

gaps.description: Asserted by the deck but never explained. This is the researcher's work order — be aggressive.
